steps.caption: Open More → Intelligence, then the Timeline tab.
Without filters it shows everything, newest first.
Each line: date, event type, how sure we are, what happened and a link to its source.
Pick a company: type 'Nimbus' and choose it from the list.
You can also pick a contact, an event type and a date range.
Now only Nimbus Ledger: tomorrow's meeting, the rejections, deal stage, job changes, requirement change and conversations.
The requirement change lists every difference and the version it came from.
Promises we made, with due dates. Overdue ones say so.
Filters appear as chips. Click ✕ on a chip to remove that filter.
Building, requirement and deal filters are set from their own pages with 'Full timeline'.
